disease_label_per_paper: Acute promyelocytic leukemia presenting with fatal intracranial hemorrhage
presentation_summary: Previously healthy 22-year-old man presented after seizure activity.
Arrival exam showed anisocoric non-reactive pupils and extensor posturing.
CT head showed a large right frontal intracranial hemorrhage with midline shift, uncal herniation, and intraventricular extension.
Intraoperative labs showed pancytopenia with WBC 4.4, hemoglobin 6.4, and platelets 7.
Peripheral smear showed blasts and promyelocytes; confirmatory molecular/cytogenetic tests are stored separately.
